topic: Inherited Characteristics from Parents to Offspring
key_concepts: Heredity is the passing of physical traits and instincts from parents to offspring
Genes are cell parts that influence the development of characters
Offspring are the young of particular parents
Physical traits determine whether the offspring is a human, an animal, or a plant
Humans may inherit physical traits such as height, body structure, eye shape, skin color,
Children may inherit mental abilities, intelligence, and talents from parents
Some diseases such as asthma, diabetes, heart disease, hypertension, and color blindness c
Young animals inherit body parts, body covering color and pattern, and eye color and shape
Behavioral traits such as hunting, movement, and self-protection can be passed to animal o
Plants reproduce their own kind through seeds, stems, leaves, roots, and spores
Mature plant traits such as root color, stem texture, leaf shape, flower color, and fruit
